message:
🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which 1937 Disney film was the first full-length cel-animated feature film ever produced in the United States?

👇 Answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs — it was such a gamble at the time that industry insiders nicknamed it 'Disney's Folly.'

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Disney's 1937 film Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs was mocked by the press as 'Disney's Folly' before release, since no one believed audiences would sit through a full-length cartoon. It went on to become the highest-grossing film of its time.

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Betty Boop debuts (1930)

Betty Boop makes her first appearance in the Fleischer Studios cartoon "Dizzy Dishes." She was originally drawn as an anthropomorphic French poodle before being redesigned as fully human.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the Scottish princess who is the protagonist of Pixar's Brave?

👇 Answer: Merida — she was Pixar's first female lead character in a film she headlines.

#Pixar #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: To achieve Bambi's realistic deer movement, Disney animators studied live fawns kept on the studio lot, and animator Marc Davis dissected animal anatomy references to get the musculature right.

#Disney #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

In 1928, Walt Disney and animator Ub Iwerks introduced Mickey Mouse to the world, launching a character who would become the face of an entire entertainment empire.

#Disney #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which studio made Wallace & Gromit using stop-motion clay figures instead of computer animation?

👇 Answer: Aardman Animations, the British studio based in Bristol, England.

#Aardman #StopMotion #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: The 'multiplane camera,' which gave Disney's early features their sense of depth, stacked painted glass panels at different distances from the camera lens, letting foreground and background move at different speeds to mimic real depth.

#Disney #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Rugrats premieres (1991)

Nickelodeon's "Rugrats" debuts, becoming one of the network's earliest Nicktoons. The babies'-eye-view sitcom went on to run for over a decade and spawn three theatrical films.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In Toy Story, what is Buzz Lightyear's catchphrase?

👇 Answer: 'To infinity and beyond!' — a line so iconic it's been used in Disney marketing for decades.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Walt Disney personally voiced Mickey Mouse from the character's 1928 debut all the way through 1947, doing the falsetto voice himself in most shorts.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Disney's 1937 Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs proved that audiences would sit through a full-length animated feature, opening the door for every animated movie that followed.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What was the first anime film to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature?

👇 Answer: Spirited Away, directed by Hayao Miyazaki, which won in 2003.

#Anime #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Pinocchio's Jiminy Cricket almost didn't exist as a character until late in production; he was added to give the story a moral narrator, and 'When You Wish Upon a Star' was written specifically to establish him.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Bambi hits theaters (1942)

Disney's "Bambi" goes into wide release. Animators studied live fawns on the studio lot to get the deer's anatomy and movement right, giving the film an unusually naturalistic look for its era.

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which Warner Bros. character was famously voiced by Mel Blanc for decades, including in the 1957 short 'What's Opera, Doc?'

👇 Answer: Bugs Bunny — Blanc voiced dozens of Looney Tunes characters across his career.

#LooneyTunes #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: One Hundred and One Dalmatians was the first Disney animated feature to use Xerography to transfer animators' pencil drawings directly onto animation cels, saving enormous time compared to hand-inking every line.

#Disney #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

The 'multiplane camera,' used on early Disney features, stacked painted glass panels at different distances from the lens to give flat, hand-drawn scenes a real sense of depth.

#Disney #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What color is Shrek?

👇 Answer: Green — specifically a swamp-ogre green that became one of the most recognizable character designs of the 2000s.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Sleeping Beauty was filmed in a widescreen format called Technirama and took nearly six years and a then-record $6 million to make, making it one of the most expensive animated films of its era.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Fleischer Studios pioneered rotoscoping in the 1910s, tracing over live-action footage frame by frame to give animated characters unusually realistic human movement.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which Pixar film features a Mexican grandmother, a talking skeleton dog, and the Land of the Dead?

👇 Answer: Coco, released in 2017.

#Pixar #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: The Jungle Book was the last animated feature Walt Disney personally supervised before his death in 1966; he insisted on adding more comedy after finding an early cut too dark.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

UPA, a mid-century American studio, pushed animation toward flatter, more stylized 'limited animation,' deliberately rejecting Disney's push toward full, realistic motion.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of Wallace's loyal dog in the Wallace & Gromit series?

👇 Answer: Gromit — he never speaks a single word throughout the entire series.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Disney's 1970s films leaned on reused animation to cut costs; several dance and chase sequences in Robin Hood and The Aristocats trace back to rotoscoped footage from earlier Disney films.

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: First animated cartoon (1908)

Émile Cohl's "Fantasmagorie" is released in Paris. Made of roughly 700 individual drawings, it is widely considered the first fully hand-drawn animated cartoon in film history.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which 1988 anime film, set in a dystopian Neo-Tokyo, is considered a landmark of adult animation?

👇 Answer: Akira, directed by Katsuhiro Otomo.

#Anime #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: The Little Mermaid marked the start of the 'Disney Renaissance' and was the first Disney animated feature to be based on a Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale, with animators studying real fish and aquariums for Ariel's underwater world.

#Disney #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Soviet studio Soyuzmultfilm produced beloved characters like Cheburashka using intricate stop-motion and cutout techniques that influenced generations of Eastern European animators.

#StopMotion #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In The Lion King, what is the name of Simba's wise mandrill mentor?

👇 Answer: Rafiki.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Beauty and the Beast became the first animated film ever nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture, a feat not repeated until Up and Toy Story 3 years later under an expanded Best Picture field.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Kubo and the Two Strings (2016)

Laika's stop-motion adventure "Kubo and the Two Strings" opens in theaters, blending handcrafted puppets with painterly Japanese-inspired visuals and a shamisen-driven score.

#StopMotion #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which studio produced Kung Fu Panda, Shrek, and How to Train Your Dragon?

👇 Answer: DreamWorks Animation.

#DreamWorks #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: The Lion King's stampede sequence used early computer animation to generate a herd of wildebeest, blending traditional hand-drawn characters with CGI backgrounds and effects.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Czech animator Jiří Trnka, sometimes called the 'Walt Disney of Eastern Europe,' pioneered elaborate puppet-animation features in the 1940s and 1950s.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the young witch who moves to a new town to complete her training in a Studio Ghibli classic?

👇 Answer: Kiki, from Kiki's Delivery Service.

#StudioGhibli #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Mulan's army of animators studied traditional Chinese brush painting and silk-scroll art to shape the film's backgrounds and character designs.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Friz Freleng is born (1905)

Isadore "Friz" Freleng, the Warner Bros. director behind countless Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies classics, is born. He helped shape the comic timing that defined the studio's golden age.

#LooneyTunes #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which animated character is known for saying 'What's up, Doc?' while chewing a carrot?

👇 Answer: Bugs Bunny.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Aladdin's Genie was animated primarily by Eric Goldberg, who built the character's rubbery, ever-shifting design specifically around Robin Williams' improvised vocal performance.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: BoJack Horseman debuts (2014)

"BoJack Horseman" premieres on Netflix, helping usher in a new wave of adult animated streaming series that blended sharp comedy with unusually candid emotional storytelling.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What was the name of the first fully computer-animated feature film in history, released in 1995?

👇 Answer: Toy Story.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Frozen's animators developed new snow and ice simulation software just to make Elsa's ice palace and the film's blizzards look physically convincing.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Canada's National Film Board animation studio has won multiple Academy Awards for shorts, pioneering techniques like pixilation and scratch-on-film animation.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In Frozen, what is the name of Elsa's ice palace located?

👇 Answer: The North Mountain.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Zootopia's world required Disney animators to design an entire ecosystem of differently scaled neighborhoods, since a city built for both mice and elephants needs doors, trains, and buildings in multiple sizes.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Satoshi Kon passes away (2010)

Acclaimed Japanese director Satoshi Kon, celebrated for "Perfect Blue," "Millennium Actress," and "Paprika," passes away. His mind-bending visual style influenced filmmakers well beyond anime.

#Anime #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which stop-motion film follows a boy named Norman who can see and speak to the dead?

👇 Answer: ParaNorman, from Laika Studios.

#StopMotion #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Toy Story, released in 1995, was the world's first entirely computer-animated feature film, and Pixar's animators had to invent new software tools mid-production just to give Woody's flannel shirt believable wrinkles.

#Pixar #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Tim Burton is born (1958)

Director Tim Burton, whose stop-motion work includes "The Nightmare Before Christmas" and "Corpse Bride," is born. His gothic, whimsical style became a genre unto itself.

#StopMotion #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the fish who suffers from short-term memory loss in Finding Nemo?

👇 Answer: Dory.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Pixar's short film Luxo Jr., about a bouncing desk lamp, became so iconic that the lamp still appears in the company's logo before every film.

#Pixar #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Tex Avery passes away (1980)

Legendary director Tex Avery, whose manic, boundary-pushing work at Warner Bros. and MGM shaped cartoon slapstick for generations, dies at age 72.

#LooneyTunes #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which classic Disney film was the last one Walt Disney personally supervised before his death in 1966?

👇 Answer: The Jungle Book.

#Disney #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Finding Nemo's animators studied real coral reefs and fish behavior so closely that marine biologists have praised the film's underwater accuracy, even though the fish talk.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Lotte Reiniger's silhouette-animated feature The Adventures of Prince Achmed, made with intricate cut paper, predates Disney's Snow White by more than a decade.

#Disney #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In Japanese, what does the word 'anime' broadly refer to?

👇 Answer: Animation in general — outside Japan it specifically refers to Japanese-style animation.

#Anime #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Ratatouille's crew visited real French restaurants and worked with a professional chef consultant to make sure the cooking scenes, and Remy's sense of smell, felt authentic.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

The 12 basic principles of animation, including 'squash and stretch' and 'anticipation,' were codified by Disney animators Frank Thomas and Ollie Johnston in their book The Illusion of Life.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which DreamWorks film centers on an ogre who must rescue a princess to reclaim his swamp?

👇 Answer: Shrek.

#DreamWorks #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Up's famous opening montage was almost entirely dialogue-free, telling Carl and Ellie's entire life together in under five minutes and remains one of the most acclaimed sequences in animation history.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

'Squash and stretch,' a foundational animation principle, exaggerates an object's shape during fast movement, like a bouncing ball flattening on impact, to sell weight to the eye.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the tiny forest spirit that only appears in daylight in My Neighbor Totoro?

👇 Answer: It's most often simply called Totoro, though smaller spirit characters called Susuwatari (soot sprites) also appear.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Inside Out's filmmakers consulted psychologists while designing the personified emotions, and early concept art considered dozens of emotions before narrowing the cast down to five.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Traditional animators often work 'on twos,' holding each drawing for two frames of film, a shortcut that keeps motion smooth while roughly halving the drawings needed.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which classic cartoon duo constantly chases each other across a desert using elaborate mail-order contraptions?

👇 Answer: Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Coco's production team traveled to Mexico multiple times to research Día de los Muertos traditions and hired a group of cultural consultants to guide the story respectfully.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Character 'model sheets,' reference drawings showing a character from multiple angles, let dozens of animators on the same film keep a character looking consistent.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the robot who falls in love while cleaning up a trash-covered Earth in a 2008 Pixar film?

👇 Answer: WALL-E.

#Pixar #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: WALL-E contains almost no dialogue for its first thirty minutes, a bold choice Pixar made to let the robot's body language carry the emotional weight of the story.

#Pixar #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Background painters on traditional animated films often worked entirely separately from character animators, with the two elements combined only at final compositing.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which animated film features a Scottish-set kingdom and a heroine who changes her mother into a bear?

👇 Answer: Brave.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Brave was Pixar's first film with a female protagonist and first fairy-tale setting, and animators developed new simulation technology specifically to handle Merida's mass of curly red hair.

#Pixar #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

The technique of claymation, popularized by Will Vinton and later by Aardman, involves reshaping malleable clay figures slightly between each photographed frame.

#Aardman #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In One Hundred and One Dalmatians, what is the name of the villain who wants to make a fur coat from puppies?

👇 Answer: Cruella de Vil.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: DreamWorks' Shrek was the first film to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature when the category was introduced in 2002.

#DreamWorks #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Motion capture technology records an actor's physical performance and maps it onto a digital character, a technique used everywhere from The Polar Express to modern blockbusters.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What technique does Laika Studios use to make its stop-motion character faces so expressive?

👇 Answer: 3D printing replacement faces, allowing for thousands of subtle facial expressions.

#StopMotion #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Shrek's swamp and fairy-tale-parody world was partly a response to DreamWorks founder Jeffrey Katzenberg's departure from Disney, and the film pokes gentle fun at Disney fairy-tale tropes throughout.

#Disney #DreamWorks #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

The 1982 film Tron was one of the earliest movies to feature extensive computer-generated imagery, though it was controversially deemed ineligible for a visual effects Oscar at the time.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which 1990s Disney film features a genie granting wishes to a street urchin in the city of Agrabah?

👇 Answer: Aladdin.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: How to Train Your Dragon's animators built Toothless's expressions by studying cats and dogs, aiming for a dragon that read as a loyal, curious pet rather than a monster.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Batman: TAS debuts (1992)

"Batman: The Animated Series" premieres, redefining superhero animation with its Art Deco-inspired noir visual style and unusually mature storytelling for a Saturday-morning slot.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the anime and manga franchise about a ninja named Naruto Uzumaki who dreams of becoming Hokage?

👇 Answer: Naruto.

#Anime #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Kung Fu Panda's animators traveled to China to study real kung fu forms and temple architecture, and Jack Black improvised many of Po's lines during recording sessions.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Rendering a single frame of a photorealistic CGI film can take hours per frame on a render farm, multiplied across the 24 frames needed for just one second of screen time.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which animated film series follows a Viking boy named Hiccup and his dragon Toothless?

👇 Answer: How to Train Your Dragon.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: The Prince of Egypt's parting of the Red Sea sequence took Industrial Light & Magic and DreamWorks animators years of technical work, blending traditional animation with early digital water simulation.

#DreamWorks #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

An animatic, a rough cut of a film using storyboard drawings and placeholder voice recordings, lets studios test pacing and jokes long before expensive final animation begins.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In The Simpsons, what is the name of the family's mischievous, skateboard-riding son?

👇 Answer: Bart Simpson.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Madagascar's four zoo-animal leads were designed with exaggerated, stylized proportions specifically so they would look distinct from Pixar and Disney's more realistic character designs.

#Disney #Pixar #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Super Friends debuts (1973)

"Super Friends" premieres on ABC, bringing DC's Justice League to Saturday morning cartoons and introducing a generation of kids to Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman as a team.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which Pixar film is set almost entirely inside the mind of an 11-year-old girl named Riley?

👇 Answer: Inside Out.

#Pixar #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Studio Ghibli was founded in 1985 by directors Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata along with producer Toshio Suzuki, taking its name from a hot desert wind, reflecting their hope to blow a fresh wind through the anime industry.

#StudioGhibli #Anime #Animation #MovieTrivia

🎬 ON THIS DAY: "9" opens on 9/9/09 (2009)

Shane Acker's post-apocalyptic stop-motion-style animated feature "9" opens in theaters on the symbolic date of September 9, 2009.

#StopMotion #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What was the name of Betty Boop's original animal form before she was redesigned as a human character?

👇 Answer: An anthropomorphic French poodle.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: My Neighbor Totoro's title character has become Studio Ghibli's official mascot and appears in the studio's opening logo.

#StudioGhibli #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Storyboard artists on animated films typically draw thousands of rough panels to plan a movie's shots and pacing, functioning like a film's visual script.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which animated feature follows a group of prehistoric rabbits searching for a new warren after their home is destroyed?

👇 Answer: Watership Down.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Spirited Away was the first anime film to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, and remained the highest-grossing film in Japanese box office history for nearly two decades.

#Anime #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Aardman Animations still shoots its Wallace & Gromit films almost entirely with handmade clay and plasticine figures rather than computer graphics.

#Aardman #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: In Spirited Away, what is the name of the bathhouse where Chihiro must work?

👇 Answer: Aburaya, run by the witch Yubaba.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Princess Mononoke's forest spirits and setting were partly inspired by Miyazaki's research trips into Japan's ancient Yakushima forest, home to trees thousands of years old.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Laika Studios pioneered using 3D-printed replacement faces on its stop-motion puppets, allowing far subtler facial expressions than hand-sculpted clay alone.

#StopMotion #AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which classic Hanna-Barbera cartoon dog solves mysteries alongside a group of teenagers in a van called the Mystery Machine?

👇 Answer: Scooby-Doo.

#RetroCartoons #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Grave of the Fireflies director Isao Takahata insisted on realistic wartime detail, reportedly researching actual firebombing survivor accounts to portray the siblings' hardships accurately.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Scooby-Doo debuts (1969)

"Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!" premieres on CBS. The Great Dane and his mystery-solving teenage friends became one of the most enduring franchises in animation history.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the tailor mouse who helps make Cinderella's ballgown in the Disney classic?

👇 Answer: Gus (Gus-Gus), alongside Jaq.

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Howl's Moving Castle's title contraption was designed with a chaotic mix of mismatched parts on purpose, meant to visually represent the wizard Howl's fractured, hidden heart.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Stop-motion animators physically move puppets millimeter by millimeter, meaning a skilled animator might complete only a few seconds of usable footage in a full day's work.

#StopMotion #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which animated film reimagines the Aztec Day of the Dead through a boy named Manolo?

👇 Answer: The Book of Life.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Porco Rosso follows a World War I flying ace cursed to have the head of a pig, one of Miyazaki's more unusual and personal passion projects, rooted in his lifelong love of aviation.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Captain Planet debuts (1990)

"Captain Planet and the Planeteers" debuts in syndication, delivering environmental messages through a team of teens who could combine their rings to summon a superhero.

#Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the fire demon who serves the wizard in Howl's Moving Castle?

👇 Answer: Calcifer.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Ponyo's hand-painted ocean scenes reportedly required over 170,000 individual frames of animation, with Miyazaki wanting the water itself to feel alive and expressive.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: This week in animation history

Loving Vincent, animated almost entirely through oil paintings, had over 100 painters create tens of thousands of individual frames in the style of Vincent van Gogh.

#AnimationHistory #CartoonFacts #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which classic Disney villain famously sings 'Poor Unfortunate Souls'?

👇 Answer: Ursula, the sea witch from The Little Mermaid.

#Disney #Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Aardman Animations, the British studio behind Wallace & Gromit, still shoots its films almost entirely with stop-motion clay and plasticine figures rather than switching to CGI.

#Aardman #StopMotion #Animation #MovieTrivia

🎬 ON THIS DAY: Transformers cartoon debuts (1984)

"The Transformers" launches with its three-part pilot, "More Than Meets the Eye." Animated by Toei in Japan, it turned a toy line into a global multimedia franchise.

#Animation #MovieTrivia #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: What is the name of the amnesiac robot hero of the animated film The Iron Giant?

👇 Answer: The Iron Giant himself is unnamed at first, but is often just called 'the giant' or affectionately named by Hogarth.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Wallace and Gromit's Wallace was voiced for decades by Peter Sallis, who continued in the role well into his nineties before eventually passing the character to a new voice actor.

#Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🎬 ON THIS DAY: DuckTales premieres (1987)

Disney's "DuckTales" debuts in syndication, sending Scrooge McDuck and his grand-nephews on treasure-hunting adventures and helping launch Disney's TV animation renaissance.

#Disney #Animation #AnimationHistory #SilentFrameStudio

🧠 ANIMATION TRIVIA: Which studio is responsible for The Boxtrolls, Coraline, and Kubo and the Two Strings?

👇 Answer: Laika Studios.

#StopMotion #Animation #AnimatedFilms #SilentFrameStudio

🎨 DID YOU KNOW: Chicken Run took Aardman and DreamWorks over four years to shoot in stop motion, using hundreds of handmade chicken puppets with interchangeable expressions.
